historical_failure.observed: Sync consumer previously read fourteen records and reported assignment partition zero. Several blocking metadata/group/time calls intervened before seek returned State. The other four seek cases were skipped by the group dependency.
historical_failure.native_diagnosis: At native release 2.15.0 rd_kafka_seek waits for the fetcher result. rd_kafka_toppar_seek returns State for a fetch state below OFFSET_QUERY, excluding STOPPING, which returns PrevInProgress. Thus the assignment snapshot did not establish the later active-fetcher precondition.
historical_failure.limit: The saved log alone does not identify the native transition. The new native-only reproduction shows duplicate topic/partition identity; parent lifetime and late finalizer ordering are under investigation. No max-poll or broker event is asserted as the cause.
